paper_id: Gu et al. - 2014 - Intelligent sleep stage mining service with smartphones
title: Intelligent Sleep Stage Mining Service with Smartphones
motivation: 现有睡眠监测方法代价高或精度低,普通人难以便捷获取高质量睡眠分析
problem_framing: 如何利用手机内置传感器感知睡眠相关事件并推断睡眠阶段
key_insight: 不同睡眠阶段伴随特定身体运动和声音事件,CRF可建模时序依赖关系
method_signature: 加速度+麦克风+光感多模态特征输入CRF,每5分钟检测一次睡眠阶段
evaluation_criteria: 与Zeo(EEG)对比准确率,与Jawbone/SleepAsAndroid对比唤醒服务质量
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 检测准确率64.55%无法媲美专业医学设备,仅提供普适性睡眠服务
evidence_for_taste: sleep quality is actually determined by
large body movements like body rollovers usually occur when people are in light sleep
tiny body movements such as arm trembling and leg jerking usually occur in deep sleep
somniloquy occurs frequently during REM because of continual dreams
The CPU share of Sleep Hunter stays stable from 5% to 9%
Sleep Hunter cannot take place of those professional medical devices
if the deep sleep stage occurs in the first hour after the user falls asleep and lasts more than 10 minutes, the possibility of its recurrence is high
thinking_moves: 把睡眠感知问题从医学领域移到日常手机场景,强调便利性而非医学精度
先通过实验验证身体运动和声音事件与睡眠阶段的关联性,再构建统计模型
承认当前精度的局限性,明确系统定位为日常普适服务而非医疗替代品
从时间维度观察睡眠阶段分布与年龄的相关性,用小样本观察推断生理机制
对现有商业产品仅用单一指标(运动量)做睡眠阶段判断的做法进行隐含批评
